verdict.rationale: Expensify documents in-product travel booking for flights, hotels, cars and rail, and positions its travel solution so that trips 'don't end in a pile of receipts'. It also shows the pieces the story needs: corporate-card import and automatic SmartScan receipt capture. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly says bookings, card transactions and receipts are grouped automatically into a single report tied to the trip itinerary. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic trip/itinerary-linked report creation, evidence that booking costs and card transactions auto-attach to that report, independent or hands-on corroboration.
